mappings.note: Sub-part (a) is draw and label the female reproductive system, which is exactly C-5.1-LO-1; sub-part (b) traces release to implantation via fertilisation, which is LO-4. The verbal uterus item in part 5 takes LO-8 instead, because nothing is drawn there.
POOR FIT. Embryo to foetus across three trimesters, plus maternal well-being. Both sub-parts are gestation and maternal health, neither of which has an outcome in this frame.

Sub-parts (a) and (b) identify grafting and its wrapping (LO-7); sub-part (c) asks for the central process, mitosis with one parent (LO-9). The split between the twins runs through this single case study.

Identifies Rhizopus, hyphae and sporangia, and the conditions for growth. All asexual reproduction by spore formation, so LO-7 alone; nothing genetic is asked, unlike the grafting case study beside it.

Sub-parts (a) and (b), meiosis and 46 versus 23, reach only the competency C3.3 because no meiosis outcome exists; the vignette's point, why the siblings differ, is the random mixing that C-3.3-LO-5 names. Both cited because they answer different sub-parts.

Bud A and Bud B differ only in whether pollination can occur (LO-4), and the predicted result is stated as fruit development from the flower (LO-3). The plain bagging MCQ in part 2 stops at pollination and takes LO-4 alone.

The decisive reasoning is that killing insects breaks the sunflower's dependence on its pollinators while the wind-pollinated maize is untouched, so the plant-pollinator interaction outcome leads; C-4.3-LO-1 for naming the biotic and abiotic agents. Same pairing as the apple-orchard item in part 1.

Three demands, three outcomes: name stigma, style and ovary (LO-8), identify the pollen tube and the fusion as fertilisation (LO-4), and state what the swollen base becomes (LO-3). The second item in the chapter that legitimately needs all three codes.

Salmon versus pigeon on mode of fertilisation and the egg-number consequence. Every sub-part is the mode of fertilisation, so LO-4 alone; this is the case-study member of the external-versus-internal family.

Worked from anatomical charts, so C-5.1-LO-1 for reading the illustrated systems; LO-8 for naming testes, scrotum, ovary and oviduct and stating their functions. Contrast the verbal testes items, which take LO-8 alone.

POOR FIT. The vignette is the menstrual cycle end to end: uterus, ovulation, menstruation. LO-8 would cover only the naming of the uterus in sub-part (a) and C-3.2-LO-4 only the word implantation; the item's dominant subject, the cycle, has no outcome, so the competency is the honest ceiling.

LO-10 for the barrier device that prevents both pregnancy and STIs, which is the item's core; C5.2 for sub-part (a), physical versus emotional maturity, which is an ethics and human-life matter with no biology outcome, matching the three other maturity items.
